semantic.justification: Original default/copy and Any/typed-sequence constructors, caller-declared erased sequence overloads, VOID reset, typed-sequence clear, Any-sequence merge/VOID omission, exact IllegalArgumentException messages and earlier successful writes on failure are retained. Map values use actual Any ownership/equality and generated NamedValue/PropertyValue compounds. Output reallocates and assigns only Name/Value, preserving reused PropertyValue Handle/State. Native lookup copies, create-if-missing, subset match, update, key erase, size/empty/clear and signed32 unpack/default specialization retain source contracts. Original cached-hash/equality/hash functors use actual Unicode. Raw compound field assignment uses existing actual C RTL/UNO owners, without fake value/type/default providers. Host Map binds the original unspecified unordered lookup/iteration contract using exact UTF16 names, with real owned key strings/cached hashes and Any members. Native bucket layout/reserve/iteration order, allocation-failure traces, threading and physical ABI are unverified. Native end/erase(iterator), implicit map copy assignment and unconsumed getUnpackedValueOrDefault template specializations are not ported. JSON/reflection conversion in the original source is a separate header-owned API and remains unported. No native compiled SequenceAsHashMap differential capture or ported downstream QA is claimed. TablePositionHandler/TableManager/DomainMapperTableManager, full DOCX/XLSX model/export and production UI workflows remain incomplete. Broad parity/default/verified flags stay false.
